en: A vintage postcard image showing a cityscape with a river, a bridge, and historic European buildings. A notable baroque church with a green onion dome stands prominently on the right. On the hill behind, a large clock tower (with a cone-shaped roof) is visible, likely a city landmark. The scene features early 20th-century street life with pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage. There is a sign on one of the buildings with partially legible text.
